label: gather_materials
description: Product display of the Crafts&Co candle kit — finished sample candles and supplies arranged on a tiered stand.

label: measure_wax
description: Wax flakes are poured from a bag onto a pan on an induction hob; a phone timer is set.

label: melt_wax
description: White wax melts in a metal bowl over the induction pan, stirred with a spatula; '2 MIN' timer.

label: melt_wax
description: Continued stirring of the molten wax in the bowl, something added; '3 MIN' timer.

label: pour_wax
description: Molten wax is poured from the bowl into a silicone mould resting on a wooden board.

label: pour_wax
description: The silicone mould fills; hands steady and squeeze the flexible white mould.

label: cure_cool
description: Filled white silicone mould (shaped cavities) sits on the board to set; a hand presses it.

label: cure_cool
description: The filled mould is held/inspected as the wax cools.

label: cure_cool
description: Wait captions ('23H'); the mould is placed in a bowl of water to speed cooling.

label: decorate_finish
description: Caption 'TIP'; the set candle is flexed out of the silicone mould ('2.5H').

label: decorate_finish
description: The white moulded candle is peeled fully from the silicone mould.

label: reveal_result
description: Finished moulded candles displayed beside a vase, then shown lit.
